label: Diagnostics (passive health report)
type: a passive, no-I/O snapshot of the SDK's already-known socket/connection state (no active network probe, may be stale) - contrasted with the active sdk:ping; exposes a cumulative ClusterState (ONLINE/DEGRADED/OFFLINE) unavailable from ping
note: Cross-product namespace fork, resolved: python-sdk/concept-docs/health-check.json independently minted 'sdk:diagnostics-check' for the identical mechanism ('Diagnostics returns a list of the nodes that the SDK currently has (or had) a connection to ... does not actively poll the nodes' vs. java-sdk/howtos/health-check.json's '`Diagnostics` shows what the SDK _perceives_ as the current state of the network and services — it is without side-effects, but may not be up to date'). Filed under the shorter Java spelling, matching the SDK's own method name (diagnostics()); see aliases.
